projects.title: My Projects
projects.workProcessTitle: How I Have Organized My Work

hollowbloom.title: Hollowbloom
hollowbloom.about: A 2D action platformer for the browser, built in plain JavaScript on an HTML5 canvas. The path leads through a mossy forest full of boars, dark elves and skeletons. At the end, the boss Verdan waits with two phases.
hollowbloom.workProcess: I split the game into small classes: world, characters, enemies, boss and items. Shared values such as timings, hitboxes and key bindings live in one file, and all texts in a translation file. That way, the game can be extended without touching the logic.
hollowbloom.learnings: I learned a lot about object-oriented JavaScript, a fixed-timestep game loop and level design with LDtk. Small details like hit-stop, screen shake and a smooth camera showed me how much polish shapes the feel of a game.

pokedex.title: Pokédex
pokedex.about: A Pokédex that shows every Pokémon as a trading card, loaded live from the PokéAPI. New cards appear as you scroll, the search suggests names, and a click opens a holographic detail view with types, evolution stage and attacks.
pokedex.workProcess: The project is split into small modules for data, grid, search, dialog and templates, and each file has one job. Functions stay short, names say what they do, and all API requests and data mapping sit in one place.
pokedex.learnings: With plain JavaScript and no framework, I practiced asynchronous code with async/await, working with a REST API and rendering dynamic content. Infinite scroll, a native dialog and keyboard navigation made me think about loading states, errors and accessibility.

join.title: Join
join.about: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
join.workProcess: How do you keep your code clean and maintainable? Have you broken the project down into reusable modules or components? Focus on documentation, naming files, variables, classes and testing.
join.groupWork: How many people were in the team and what was your role? Describe your tasks in 1-2 sentences, for example: login form, dashboard or chat functionality. What technologies did you use? It is nice to mention good teamwork and cooperation.
